title: D2P Command
description: Protocol-independent command envelope (documentType 'd2p:command', design decision ADR-019). A command addresses the head of a branch of one artifact ('target') and, except for artifact creation, names the revision it expects to be the current head ('expectedRevisionId', optimistic concurrency). Schema-enforced: 'd2p:artifact.create' forbids 'expectedRevisionId', every other 'd2p:' type requires it; the payload shape depends on 'type'; the content schema of a create command depends on 'payload.artifactType'. Payloads of extension command types are open objects, and their payload specification decides about 'expectedRevisionId'.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against. An embedded create 'content' document MUST state the same version (D2P-STR-003).

commandId.description: Unique ID of this command, chosen by the client. A revision produced by the command records it as 'commandId'.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key that makes retries of the same command safe. Reusing a key for a different command is answered with error code 'idempotency_key_reused'.

type.description: Command type (extensible vocabulary). Selects the payload shape.

target.description: Artifact and branch the command writes to. This is a branch address, not a pinned reference.

expectedRevisionId.description: Revision the client expects to be the current head of 'target'. Forbidden for 'd2p:artifact.create', required for every other 'd2p:' command type. If the head differs, the command is rejected with 'stale_revision'; it is never silently applied to another revision.

payload.description: Command data. 'd2p:artifact.create' uses 'createArtifactPayload', 'd2p:pattern.parameters.update' uses 'updateParametersPayload'; payloads of extension command types are open objects.

actorContext.description: Who issues the command, as opaque principal and client IDs.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID propagated to the receipt, resulting events and errors.

issuedAt.description: UTC time at which the client issued the command. Informative.

evaluatorProfile.description: Evaluator profile the client expects to be used for derived results of this command. Informative.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-c14n-v1 over the whole document, excluding 'contentDigest' itself).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

commandType.title: Command type
commandType.description: Extensible command-type vocabulary: the listed 'd2p:' terms or an extension name. An unknown 'd2p:' term is a structural error.

anyOf.description: Command types defined by this standard.

commandTarget.title: Command target
commandTarget.description: Branch address of the artifact a command writes to. It is not a reference: it names a branch head and is paired with 'expectedRevisionId'.

artifactId.description: Artifact written to. For 'd2p:artifact.create' it is the client-chosen ID of the new artifact.

branch.description: Branch name. In standard 1.0 the branch is 'main'.

actorContext.title: Actor context
actorContext.description: Identity context of a command. All members are opaque IDs, never secrets, tokens, passwords, names or e-mail addresses.

actorPrincipalId.description: Principal (person, agent or system) that issues the command.

onBehalfOfPrincipalId.description: Principal on whose behalf the actor acts (for example the user an agent works for). Absent when the actor acts on its own behalf.

clientId.description: Opaque ID of the client application. Never a secret.

credentialId.description: Opaque ID of the credential used (for audit). Never the credential itself or any other secret.

createArtifactPayload.title: Create artifact payload
createArtifactPayload.description: Payload of 'd2p:artifact.create'. The embedded 'content' is the complete artifact content document of the first revision; its header carries 'artifactId' = 'target.artifactId' and 'revisionId' = 'initialRevisionId' (D2P-REF-007). An implementation either commits the first revision under exactly these client-proposed IDs or rejects the command with error code 'conflict'; it never substitutes other IDs silently.

artifactType.description: Type of the new artifact. Closed for this command: one of the six 'd2p:' artifact types. Selects the schema of 'content'.

name.description: Name of the new artifact (artifact metadata).

dataClassification.description: Data classification of the new artifact (artifact metadata). It MUST agree with a classification stated in the content (D2P-SEM-051).

initialRevisionId.description: Client-proposed ID of the first revision; equals the 'revisionId' in the content header.

content.description: Complete artifact content document of the first revision, with its own header. Its schema is selected by 'artifactType'.

updateParametersPayload.title: Update parameters payload
updateParametersPayload.description: Payload of 'd2p:pattern.parameters.update': new expressions for existing parameters of the target pattern.

parameterUpdate.title: Parameter update
parameterUpdate.description: Replaces the expression of one pattern parameter. The new expression MUST evaluate to the parameter's declared dimension (D2P-SEM-002).

parameterId.description: Element ID of the parameter in the target pattern.

expr.description: New expression of the parameter (typed AST, closed node list).
